name: Centre Pompidou
notes: Centre Pompidou (Renzo Piano and Richard Rogers, 1977): the steel frame of fourteen portal frames at 12.8 m, 166 m long and 60 m deep, about 42 m high in six levels over the ground; the glass body inside the white structure, with the gerberettes and the outer ties and X-bracing on both long sides. The piazza (west) front carries the escalator in its glass tube, climbing diagonally toward the south, and the gallery tube along the top; rue du Renard (east) carries the services in their colour code (blue air, green water, yellow electricity, red lifts and movement). Written from general knowledge of the building; the ground file gives the footprint and its orientation, which is turned about 16 degrees off north — the parts are square to the axes, so the model stands on true north-south, a little straighter than the building. Guessed: the exact duct layout and escalator flights. No photographs were available.
